text: Long coffee with Joy. Her housewarming is Saturday at 7, new flat in Leith, and Theo's bringing his decks apparently. She said she's skint after the move so I'm doing a cheese board. Text her the day before to check numbers.
Theo's puppy arrived Sunday, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. He's barely slept. Already chewed through a charger cable.

Catch-up with Tariq after standup. His manager Leon is leaving at the end of the month and Tariq's been asked to cover the client side till they hire. He seems knackered but up for it. Leaving drinks are the 30th at half 5.
Jin's cat Miso has to have a tooth out Thursday morning. She's anxious about the anaesthetic because he's fourteen. Message her Thursday afternoon to see how he got on.
Dinner at Eva and Bethany's was lovely. They're celebrating five years together on the 9th and going to Porto for the weekend after. Eva hates seafood so Bethany's already scouting steak places.
Niamh rang. Her mum's 70th is Sunday 2nd, lunch at the Shore at 1pm, and I'm invited. Must get a card by Friday.
Marisol's client presentation got moved to Monday at 10. Her boss Aurelio wants her to lead it, first time, and she's properly nervous. Wish her luck Sunday night. Afterwards we said we'd grab lunch.
Eamon's barbecue is off, his dad's back in hospital. Doing a pint with him next week instead, just us.
Quick one - Lars mentioned his dog Pepper turns one on the 14th. They're doing a doggy cake. He's very serious about it.
Julien starts at the agency on the 3rd, account director. He said Farid from his old team is going with him. Ask him how the first week went, maybe the Friday after.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 9, then post office.

Kwame and Efua invited us to their daughter's christening on the 18th at 11am, party at theirs afterwards. Efua says the baby's sleeping better now. Kwame's mum is flying over from Accra the week before.
Saskia at work is struggling. Her rabbit died last weekend and then Karim, her line manager, put her on a performance plan Tuesday. She didn't want to talk much. Check in on her Friday.

Noah's leaving do is next Thursday from 6, upstairs at the Canny Man. Everyone's chipping in for a gift, Obi is collecting. Noah keeps going on about wanting a decent coffee grinder, so that might be it.
Talked to Rosa about her new job at the vets. She loves it. Gets to cuddle kittens all day, her words.
Grace and Dev are hosting a Diwali dinner Saturday the 7th, 7pm. Grace is vegetarian, Dev isn't, they argue about it constantly. I'm bringing dessert.
Nasser said the client meeting with Hughes & Co went badly yesterday afternoon. His boss blamed him in front of everyone. Need to give him a ring tonight.
Jonah's got his performance review Wednesday at 2. He thinks he's in line for senior. Remind me Wednesday evening to ask how it went.

Valentina "Val" Fernández came round with her new kitten, Churro. Tiny, ginger, absolute menace. She's off to Seville the 22nd for her sister's wedding and needs someone to feed him. I said I'd do mornings.
Adebayo mentioned Kavya from finance is pregnant, due in March. She's not telling the wider team till after the scan on the 5th.
Caitlin's cat Pudding has been off his food. Vet appointment tomorrow at 4. She's worried it's his kidneys again. Text her after.
Joy said Reggie got the promotion! Head of ops from January. Party Friday at hers, 8ish. Send congrats tonight.
Theo was telling me about his brother Noah, who's moving to Glasgow next month for uni. Theo's helping drive the van down the morning of the 12th.
Did the vet run for Mum's dog this morning. All fine, booster done.

Dinner with Tariq, Jin and Eva. Tariq's sister Caitlin is getting married in June and he's best man, terrified about the speech. Jin's thinking of quitting her job to retrain as a vet nurse. Eva's back from Lisbon and has gone full pastéis de nata obsessive. Must sort a date for Tariq's speech practice, maybe the week before the stag.
Bethany's birthday drinks Saturday at 9 at the Bongo Club. She dropped hints about wanting tickets to the Wolf Alice gig.
Niamh's started at Kaur Digital as a junior designer. Her manager is Dev, small world. She says the office has a resident dog called Bramble.
Marisol and Aurelio had the big client pitch this morning. Apparently it went really well. Need to find out if they won it, they hear Friday.
Rang Eamon. His dad's surgery went fine yesterday and he's home the day after tomorrow. Eamon sounded relieved but tired. I'll pop round with soup on Sunday.
Note for Saturday: I'm doing the drinks for Lars's housewarming, picking up ice the morning of.
Julien's partner Farid had his citizenship ceremony on Tuesday. They had a little do afterwards. Should send something, even late.
Kwame's struggling with his new boss, Mr Nowak, who micromanages everything. Kwame's thinking about applying elsewhere. Efua wants him to wait till after Christmas.
Saskia's got a new puppy! A whippet called Noodle. She seems way happier. Puppy classes start the 10th at 6pm.
Karim from the client side invited me to their launch party on the 28th at 7. Need to RSVP by Monday.
Obi told me his grandma passed away on the weekend. Funeral's next Wednesday at 11, in Lagos, he's flying out Monday night. Don't forget to message him the day before.
Rosa's dog Bear had his first birthday yesterday. She threw a party with other dogs from the park. Proper lunatic, love her.
Grace has her driving test Thursday at 8.40am. She failed the last one and she's dreading it. Text good luck Wednesday night.
Nasser and Valentina are doing a joint 30th on the 15th, fancy dress, at Nasser's place. Theme's 'films from the 90s'. Need a costume.
Lunch with Jonah. He's coeliac, so Pizza Express was a fail. Mentioned his brother Obi just got engaged in Ghana.
Adebayo's annual review got postponed again, now the 20th at 11. He's fed up with it. His boss Mrs Walsh keeps rescheduling.
Kavya's cat Tikka went missing two nights ago. Posters up around Morningside. She's in bits. Call her tomorrow morning.
Caitlin MacDonald, new client lead from Wright's, seems great. Loves fell running. Into board games too, mentioned Wingspan.

Caught up with Joy and Theo at the pub. Joy's thinking about getting a dog but her landlord's being difficult. Theo has a stag do in Berlin the first weekend of November, his mate Reggie's. Theo's also got his PhD viva on the 21st at 10am, says he's fine, clearly isn't. I should send him something the day before.
Eva's leaving the firm. Last day is Friday the 31st. Drinks at 5 afterwards at the usual place.
Need to buy dog food and book the boiler service.
Tariq and his wife are expecting twins! Due in April. His wife's had awful morning sickness. They told me after dinner tonight.
Bethany's dog Hamish had an operation on his leg on Monday. Recovery is six weeks, crate rest. Bethany working from home all week. Check on her and Hamish at the weekend.
Marisol's birthday is the 3rd. She wants a plant, something hard to kill.
Aurelio's interview at Kumar Partners is tomorrow at 3pm. Second round. He's calm about it. Ask him Thursday how it went.
Lars's housewarming last night was great. Met his flatmate Karim and the cat, Sergeant Whiskers. Lars said the flat is in Marchmont, top floor, no lift.
Julien's dinner party was cancelled, he's got covid. Rescheduled to the 14th at 7.30.
Farid's mum is retiring next month after 30 years teaching. Big surprise party on the 22nd, Farid's organising. I'm on decorations.
Efua mentioned their cat Ama had kittens, five of them! She's looking for homes in about 8 weeks. Ask her if one's still free the week after next.
Leon said his daughter starts nursery on Monday morning. He's more nervous than she is. Then he's off to Dublin for a client thing the next day.
Karim's wedding anniversary is the 19th. He asked me to cover his shift that evening. Said yes.
Noah had his appraisal this afternoon with his manager Grace. He got a pay rise and is chuffed. We're doing celebratory drinks tomorrow after work.
Obi's partner Rosa finally passed her vet nursing exams last week. Obi's planning a surprise dinner Saturday at 8, I'm invited. Shh.
Dev is struggling with his back again, physio Tuesday at 9am. Can't sit at his desk for long. His boss has been decent about it though.
Nothing much, sat in the garden. Spent the afternoon reading.

Video call with Valentina, Jonah and Adebayo. Val's sister got engaged in Seville at the weekend. Jonah's moving to Bristol in January for his partner's job, flat viewing on the 4th. Adebayo's cat Pixel is 10 on Friday and he's ordered a cake. Remind me to post Jonah a moving card the week after he goes.
